profile.headline: Software Engineer I at Intelligrated
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineering Technician with a demonstrated history of working in the retail industry. Skilled in Microsoft Word, Java, C#, Microsoft Excel, and Linux. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science - BS focused in Computer Engineering from University of Kentucky.

positions.title: Technician
positions.description: Primary work includes diagnostics and repairs of Apple's Mac and iOS based products. Services include screen repairs, battery replacements and other hardware and software related work. Work also includes floor sales of available Apple products and accessories as well as troubleshooting of Apple products.

positions.title: Courtesy Clerk
positions.description: Provide customer service while fulfilling many duties including bagging, lot duty, item returns and store maintenance. Working in fast paced environment while maintaining healthy personal relationships with customer and employees alike.

positions.title: Buck 4 Brains Research
positions.description: Research program offered by University of Kentucky Professor for added learning and experience. Worked with team of engineering students on Linux focused workshop to teach biomedical students about useful tools in their field. Work consisted of trouble shooting the programs and direct interaction with students to help them gain a better understanding of the available tools and Linux work environment.

positions.title: Starbucks Barista
positions.description: Work consisted of production of customized drinks for customers in a fast team oriented work environment and management of store kiosk. Roles in this area included maintenance of work station and organization of stock. Employees were expected to fulfill customer needs and complaints accordingly while keeping a positive and friendly relationship with each customer.
